hints.title: Anchor Last Elements
hints.text: All elements in nums1 must be <= nums1[n - 1] and in nums2 <= nums2[n - 1]. The only choice for the final pair is to swap index n - 1 or keep it.

hints.title: Two Candidate Scenarios
hints.text: Evaluate case A: target (nums1[n-1], nums2[n-1]) with 0 initial swaps, and case B: target (nums2[n-1], nums1[n-1]) with 1 initial swap.

hints.title: Greedy Feasibility Check
hints.text: For each index i < n - 1, if values already satisfy the target, cost is 0. If swapping satisfies them, cost is 1. If neither works, the scenario is invalid.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two linear verification passes for both boundary swap choices.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining 2^n swap configurations is unnecessary given target constraints at index n - 1.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that fixing index n - 1 leaves each preceding position with a deterministic requirement.
